hint.text:
If the word ends in a 'k' sound, the ending is '-que'.
If the word ends in a 'g' sound, the ending is '-gue'.
hint.sound: If the word ends in a k sound, the ending is q u e. If the word ends in a g sound, the ending is g u e.

instruction.text: Complete the word by writing the correct ending.

atoms.a: The dancers had excellent technique in their performance.
atoms.b: The dancers had excellent techni((que)) in their performance.

atoms.a: My brother and I argue all the time.
atoms.b: My brother and I ar((gue)) all the time.

atoms.a: The window is almost completely opaque.
atoms.b: The window is almost completely opa((que)).

atoms.a: My favourite dessert is meringue, cream and fruit.
atoms.b: My favourite dessert is merin((gue)), cream and fruit.

instruction.text: Complete the sentence by spelling the word correctly.

atoms.a: I paid in a cheque to the bank.
atoms.b: I paid in a ((cheque)) to the bank.

atoms.a: My favourite part of the play was the main character’s monologue.
atoms.b: My favourite part of the play was the main character’s ((monologue)).

atoms.a: The girls in the class quickly formed a clique.
atoms.b: The girls in the class quickly formed a ((clique)).

atoms.a: The epilogue of the novel was interesting.
atoms.b: The ((epilogue)) of the novel was interesting.
